versions.changelog:
Initial release: Generate high-quality real estate marketing copy across multiple formats.

- Write MLS listing descriptions, emails, social media posts, open house scripts, follow-up sequences, objection handling scripts, agent bios, and newsletters.
- Includes templates and prompt formulas for various property types, transaction stages, platforms, and use cases.
- Guides users to provide key details for better, more personalized copy.
- Designed for instant, professional results tailored for the real estate industry.
